newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Edegel signs $450 mln accord with Cominco.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Edegel signs $450 mln accord with Cominco.

text.p: Peruvian electricity generator Edegel has signed a 15-year, $450 million contract with Cominco Ltd to supply energy to the zinc miner's Cajamarquilla refinery, the utility company said Tuesday.
Edegel said in a statement it would be the sole supplier to Cajamarquilla from 2001 and would provide about one million megawatt-hours of electrical energy each year.

The Cajamarquilla refinery, which is near Lima, is 82-percent owned by Cominco -- considered the world's largest zinc producer -- and 17-percent owned by Japan's Marubeni Corporation. Workers hold a one percent stake.
Edegel, a blue chip stock on the Lima bolsa, is Peru's largest private electricity generator.
